What the task says and its priority are fields of the one
editor; the board is not, a task staying on the board it
was created on for its whole life. Priority changes only
while the task is in the Backlog, so work in motion is sent
back there first, which re-opens its triage - by this editor
or by dragging it between the sections.
Where tasks on the board are still open, they are
disclosed with the offer and the answer travels with the
closing: close them with the activity, set them aside, or
leave them open. Where nothing is open there is nothing
to disclose and nothing to answer.
